sprite.name: THE END
sprite.game: Metal Gear Solid 3: Snake Eater (2004), original PlayStation 2
sprite.incarnation: Original 2004 PS2 The End — Sokrovenno Cobra Unit leaf-ghillie sniper

sources.scope: Official original PS2 full-body model: broad elderly silhouette, bald painted scalp, dark blue headphones, white beard, olive/tan flat-leaf ghillie, bare hands, brown ankle boots, original wood-stock scoped Mosin and green parrot on anatomical LEFT shoulder.

Original MGS3 Mosin Nagant inventory silhouette reproduced by external archive and explicitly labelled in preserved mgs3-inventory.html. Conventional scoped wood-stock bolt rifle; no railgun/PSG1/bayonet.
Original PS2 frontal high angle confirms painted bald scalp under headphone band, stocky ghillie body and parrot on anatomical LEFT shoulder.

limits: Entirely redrawn independent native pixel-art bodies of this exact incarnation; no derived pixel filter or source bitmap downsampling.
Retro is an original style adaptation, not an original MSX sprite extraction or hardware palette certification.
Actual source poses are adapted to existing gameplay move keys; every game-specific motion/weapon seam is not claimed as publisher animation extraction.
Runtime and live-match review are required separately after this candidate compilation.
